statement_ascii: For connected G,H with n(G),n(H)>=2, gamma_t(G square H) >= gamma(G direct H).
cartesian_definition: (g,h)~(g',h') iff [g=g' and hh' in E(H)] or [h=h' and gg' in E(G)]
direct_definition: (g,h)~(g',h') iff gg' in E(G) and hh' in E(H)
gamma_definition: minimum cardinality of a set whose closed neighborhoods cover every vertex
gamma_t_definition: minimum cardinality of a set whose open neighborhoods cover every vertex, including every selected vertex
status_basis: arXiv v2 still labels the statement Conjecture 3 and calls it table-true with many sharp instances
exact-statement, formula, product-name, and title searches found no indexed proof or counterexample
the v1 local campaign found no certificate and did not resolve the conjecture
limitations: This carries forward the v1 freeze-date negative public search. Recheck source status and priority before interpreting any candidate.
